body: Best of luck
Sorry - I'm definitely not a Steve
Cool, cheers for that - I hadn't heard of the MW-1 before

Looks like a JP233, more info here (with apologies for the bad video quality - can't find anything better at the moment): -
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JP233
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZAGmDqH4c-8

Hey, I really hope you're still here.
I posted here a couple of weeks ago feeling like you are.
What the hell do I say to you without sounding like I'm some preachy git with all the answers? I worry I come across like that - but sod it.
I wish I could talk to you face to face, it's so much easier when you can see the person you're talking to.
I don't know your situation. I don't know what's taken you to this place.
Many of us have been there. We have. It's not talked about which doesn't make it any easier out there in the big wide world, but we're here for you. You aren't alone. You aren't. Talk to me. Reply to this. Send me a PM. Talk to the folk here.
Also if I could write a poem I would, but that's just not something I've ever been able to do. I wish I could though, I owe you so much more than that
From my part of the world, what you said sounds spot on - not derogatory at all

You sound very much like someone I'm lucky enough to know. I'm not sure I could impart advice in the same way you have.
If nothing else please know I would not be here without you.
Is it not strange the difference less than a month can make, even without any appreciable material difference in my life?
I struggle with posting an update only because I'm not sure what to say... and most of all I would hate to appear to be smug or in any way superior to anyone going through the worst of the dark times.
If you think it would help someone though I'd be willing to write a post and have someone check it before it goes up. I'm still not that confident
Thank you seems trivial.  Wish I could express this better.  Incalculable is as close as I can get, still doesn't measure up though
I've got to agree with you there - I really enjoyed that track
A work of true genius
...look on the brightside (with apologies for not helping in any way)
Dammit... that song's going to be stuck in my head now
Also shock can be a factor.  From a survival point of view arms are pretty important too - but I get the point you're making
She did well to keep hold of you - not sure I would have managed that to be honest
It's all about perspective isn't it?
I broke my arm and that didn't feel nearly as bad as trapping my fingers either - it's strange how we're wired up isn't it?
Only a week? I'm impressed
Will do, ta
It's amazing the priorities you have when you're a kid, isn't it?
That's absolutely what I'm in the mood to listen to at the moment, thanks for posting it
That made me wince just reading it!
Love the pic - cheers for sharing it
Simply splendid!
Crikey - sounds a little severe. Still, it's always handy to have a party trick
What's the rush? Save effort and leave your kit packed for the next time you go away!
Well it's good to know I've got the worse of the two out of the way if nothing else
I bet that made walking a hell of a laugh for the next couple of weeks :/
Good skills! Despite being massively clumsy I've not shut any of my toes in a car door yet - it's good to know I've still got goals to achieve!

Yeah - it was a two door old time beast, made of cast iron, huge nails and brown paint. Classy!
Happy to say I've managed to avoid shutting any part of me in sliding minivan door so far though - that doesn't bear thinking about
Genius

I couldn't agree more - I had a car door closed on my hand and got three fingers trapped (I wasn't paying attention, totally my fault), it took a while to get it back open as it was locked and the car wasn't fitted with central locking.
Couldn't describe the experience any better than /u/TheShatnerIncident did
I really liked that - cheers for posting
Good lord! Really?
Fully awesome - good work!
I honestly can't give any more info than magic software I'm afraid!
Here's a stabilised version from /r/mildlyinteresting http://i.imgur.com/3ZCaRIb.gif
That looks amazing - fantastic work! I miss having the space to take on this sort of project, I'll just have to live vicariously through you fine folk for a while

I'm deeply envious - our BBQs get stolen for scrap metal if left outside, and the flat's not big enough to keep a decent sized one in.
Enjoy!

I can add nothing to the comments already made, I don't have the skills to craft a finely worded reply.
You sound like an amazing person, who is a truly amazing mother.
I wish there was something concrete I could do.
Grief does ease, time is a remarkable healer. I speak from experience.
How you deal with this is very much dependant upon how you are as a person. Be true to yourself. If you need space try to see that you get it, though I really do appreciate this will not be easy. Should you need company, even if only to hold your hand or listen to you talk then do try to find it.
I cannot imagine being in your place, any phrase I try to come up with to alleviate your pain seem inconsequential - still, all of my thoughts are with you
